newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela $533 mln bond issue moves step closer.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela $533 mln bond issue moves step closer.

text.p: The Venezuelan government's plans to issue $533 million worth of debt denominated in German marks moved a step closer Wednesday when the issue was approved by the influential Chamber of Deputies Finance Committee.
The government plans to use the bond issue to meet debt arrears from 1994 and 1995.
Rodrigo Cabezas, president of the Public Credit Subcommittee said the bonds will have a six-year maturity and carry a 10.66 percent interest rate.
The bond issue still requires approval by the chambers of the lower and upper houses of Congress before it can go ahead.
